clue.text: Condition under which a horse races

definitions.meaning: a clause added to a contract or bill as a proviso or stipulation
the jockey sitting on the horse's back during a race

explanation.surface: A racing rule setting the terms on which a horse may run.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface asks for racing terms; the second definition is read literally, the person on top of the horse.
explanation.definitionFit: A proviso attached to a document is a rider, and the jockey a horse carries is equally its rider.

clue.text: Did some more upholstering when fully better

definitions.meaning: put new fabric on a chair or sofa
restored to health

explanation.surface: An upholsterer finishes reupholstering on getting well again.
explanation.definitionFit: A sofa given new fabric has been re-covered, and a patient restored to health has recuperated.

clue.text: False teeth be put in as an investment

indicators.note: put in signals that the word be is placed inside the other piece

parts.note: a denture is a set of false teeth

explanation.surface: Dentures put forward as a sound place for savings.
explanation.walkthrough: 'False' looks like an anagram signal, but 'False teeth' is a single unit defining dentures; 'put in' is the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: A debenture is a bond or loan certificate issued by a company, a form of investment.

clue.text: Call and make a clear vibrant sound

definitions.meaning: telephone someone
chime as a bell does

explanation.surface: Telephoning someone and the bell chiming clearly.
explanation.definitionFit: To phone someone is one sense, and a bell's resonant chime is another.

parts.note: read as decorating: patterned paper pasted over a room's surfaces hides the cracks in the plaster

explanation.surface: A remedy for hiding faults, figuratively papering over problems.
explanation.definitionFit: Decorative paper hung on interior walls conceals blemishes and fissures in the plaster beneath.

parts.note: read literally: beaten by wind and rain, rather than the sense of worn and seasoned

explanation.surface: Someone vanquished by the forces of nature.
explanation.definitionFit: A face or building worn and roughened by exposure to wind and rain is described this way, and literally it is beaten by the elements.

indicators.note: half picks out the first four of the eight letters of the following word

explanation.surface: Half of a picture shows an early Briton.
explanation.definitionFit: The Picts were an ancient people of what is now northern Scotland.

parts.note: refers to the answer at 29 across: the one who is beaten may receive a token award, the consolation one

explanation.surface: A small comfort offered to someone.
explanation.definitionFit: A consolation award is given to a runner-up who did not win.

clue.text: Managed to get central heating at the farm

parts.note: ran means managed, as in ran a business

explanation.surface: Installing central heating on a farmstead.
explanation.definitionFit: A ranch is a large farm, especially for cattle in America.

clue.text: Chartered accountant finds waste-paper container for a private room

explanation.surface: An accountant discovers a wastebasket in his own private office.
explanation.definitionFit: A cabin is a small private compartment, as on a ship or train.

definitions.meaning: an ... is, in medical usage, a condition or ailment of the body
fondness or warm attachment

explanation.surface: A wry remark that being in love is a kind of illness.
explanation.definitionFit: Medicine uses the word for a bodily disorder, while everyday speech uses it for tender fondness.

parts.note: a fiend is a devil, and one who throws windows open for outdoor air is fiendish about ventilation

explanation.surface: Someone who behaves wickedly around windows.
explanation.definitionFit: An enthusiast who insists on open windows and outdoor air is jokingly called this kind of fanatic.

indicators.note: after places the word for close behind the numeral

parts.note: V is the Roman numeral for five

explanation.surface: A shopkeeper sells and shuts up shop after five o'clock.
explanation.definitionFit: To vend is to offer goods for sale.

clue.text: He set about making a rope

indicators.note: about signals that the letters of the words are moved around into a new order

explanation.surface: A man sets to work making a rope.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' rearranges HESET into the answer. On a sailing boat, a sheet is not a sail but the rope controlling one.
explanation.definitionFit: In sailing, the line attached to a sail's corner for trimming it is called a sheet.

definitions.meaning: to engage or interlock, as gear teeth do
a net or grid of interlaced threads

explanation.surface: Something getting caught up in a net.
explanation.definitionFit: Gears that interlock are said to engage this way, and a woven net is made of the same interlaced fabric.

clue.text: Against losing a part of the poem

indicators.note: losing signals that the letter a is dropped from the word

explanation.surface: Someone opposed to losing a bit of a poem.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Against' is not VERSUS here but AVERSE; dropping the A leaves a stanza.
explanation.definitionFit: A verse is a stanza or section of a poem.

definitions.meaning: ... flat, face down
the telling of untruths

explanation.surface: Someone inclined to tell untruths.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Prone to' looks like 'inclined to', but 'Prone' means stretched out flat and 'to' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Lying flat on the ground and telling untruths share one word.

definitions.meaning: an absurdly early or late hour of the day
read literally: an hour not of the Earth, so alien

explanation.surface: Wondering about odd hours of the day on some other world.
explanation.definitionFit: Getting up at an ungodly early hour is idiomatically this phrase, and literally it means a period of time not of our world.

clue.text: Who to blame when we make mistakes?

definitions.text: Who to blame when we make mistakes?

parts.words: Who to blame when we make mistakes?
parts.note: when we slip up, honesty says the fault is our own

explanation.surface: Asking whom to blame when errors occur.
explanation.definitionFit: The reflexive pronoun for we names the people responsible for our own errors.

parts.note: red is a colour, so colourful
a setter is someone who compiles crosswords

explanation.surface: Barker as the name of a flamboyant crossword compiler.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Barker' looks like a surname but defines a dog: the Irish red setter.
explanation.definitionFit: A red setter is a breed of dog, and dogs bark.

parts.note: fashions read as the clothes trade: someone who creates garments and styles

explanation.surface: A maker or shaper of things, in a general sense.
explanation.definitionFit: A couturier who creates frocks and gowns literally works in fashion.

definitions.meaning: a group of people of common descent or ethnicity
to rush or dash at speed

explanation.surface: A crowd of folk rushing about.
explanation.definitionFit: A nation or ethnic group is one sense, and to dash at speed is another.

clue.text: It is made to measure for the monarch

definitions.meaning: a straight edge marked in units for measuring length
a king or queen

explanation.surface: A garment tailored especially for the king.
explanation.definitionFit: A graduated measuring stick and a sovereign who governs share this name.

indicators.note: around signals that the letters of the word are turned about into a new order

explanation.surface: Dancing about after receiving a beating.
explanation.definitionFit: Being beaten with a stick or cane, as in old schools, is to be thrashed.

definitions.meaning: cloth or substance in general
to cram or fill something full

explanation.surface: Fabric being crammed into a case.
explanation.definitionFit: Fabric or matter generally is one sense, and to cram full is the verb.

definitions.meaning: only, nothing more than
a pond or lake, especially in poetry or place names

explanation.surface: A dismissive description: only a pond.
explanation.definitionFit: The adjective means nothing more than, and the noun is an old word for a lake, as in Windermere.

clue.text: In favour of a long, narrow canoe

explanation.surface: Someone supporting the use of a slender canoe.
explanation.definitionFit: A proa is a Malay or Pacific sailing boat with a long narrow hull and an outrigger.

parts.note: OP is short for opus, a work

indicators.note: almost signals that the word for everything loses its final letter

explanation.surface: Masonry laid on almost everything.
explanation.definitionFit: An opal is an iridescent gemstone.

clue.text: Covering a great distance well into thefuture

definitions.meaning: able to travel or reach far, as a missile or aircraft
planning or forecasting far ahead

explanation.surface: A forecast that reaches both far away and far ahead.
explanation.walkthrough: The printed 'thefuture' is a typesetting slip for 'the future'.
explanation.definitionFit: A far-reaching missile and a far-ahead forecast are both described with this compound.

parts.note: read literally: the spot on which something rotates, rather than a moment of change

explanation.surface: A decisive moment in a story.
explanation.definitionFit: A fulcrum or axle on which something rotates is literally a point of turning.

clue.text: Caught thus with diamonds and hearts only

definitions.meaning: caught in the act of wrongdoing
a card player holding only cards of the two scarlet suits

explanation.surface: A card cheat caught while holding a suspicious hand.
explanation.walkthrough: In a pack of cards, diamonds and hearts are the red suits, so a hand of nothing else is literally all red.
explanation.definitionFit: Being caught in the act is the idiom, and literally a hand of only scarlet-suited cards.

clue.text: Might he want to change roles with the winner?

definitions.text: Might he want to change roles with the winner?

parts.words: Might he want to change roles with the winner?
parts.note: the person beaten in a contest would gladly swap places with the victor

explanation.surface: Wondering whether the runner-up envies the champion.
explanation.definitionFit: The defeated party in a contest naturally wishes to trade places with the victor.
